evidence.quote: An unsigned post published Tuesday on the blog Civic Truth Watch claims that Nora Patel, director of the Harborlight Relief Fund, diverted donations intended for flood-recovery families to personal use.
Executive director Nora Patel said applicants can receive help with temporary housing, appliance replacement, and cleanup costs.
The release contains no discussion of the anonymous online allegation concerning Patel and provides no information about the fund's finances beyond the amount available for this grant round.
Nora Patel received the County Volunteer Partnership Award on Wednesday for coordinating a network of emergency shelters during last spring's flooding.
The county's award announcement did not address the unrelated anonymous blog claim and does not independently verify or disprove it.
